title: First-Principles Proof of Newton's Second Law and Impulse Theorem
starting_principles: Newton's definition of net force as rate of change of momentum

ordered_steps.explanation: State the fundamental definition of force as time rate of change of momentum.
Apply product rule of differentiation under invariant mass assumption dm/dt = 0.
Integrate both sides with respect to time over interval [t_1, t_2] to yield the impulse-momentum theorem.

limiting_cases: When net force is zero, dp/dt = 0 yielding constant velocity (Newton's First Law)
claim_traces: HCV1 Ch 5 p. 75; HRW Ch 5 p. 120
